title: Splash screen is shown on app launch
description: Verifies that the app shows the splash screen on initial load at the entry route.

title: Onboarding advances through slides
description: Verifies that the onboarding screen allows progressing through the onboarding slides end-to-end.

title: Account type selection screen loads and both roles are visible
description: Verifies that the role selection page renders and the user can see Client and Pro options.

title: Login screen loads with email/password inputs
description: Verifies that the login page is reachable and shows an email/password form (non-OAuth path).

title: Login fails with invalid credentials and stays on login screen
description: Verifies that incorrect email/password shows a visible error and does not navigate into authenticated routes.

title: Client user can log in and is routed to client feed
description: Verifies that a valid client account is redirected into the client role shell after authentication.

title: Pro user can log in and is routed to pro dashboard
description: Verifies that a valid pro account is redirected into the pro role shell after authentication.

title: Get Started from first onboarding slide routes to Account Type selection
description: Verifies that tapping Get Started completes onboarding and navigates to the account type selection screen.

title: Sign up as Client with valid credentials completes and routes to Complete Profile
description: Verifies the happy-path client registration flow from role selection through successful signup and navigation to the complete profile screen.

title: Sign up as Pro with valid credentials completes and routes to Complete Profile
description: Verifies the happy-path pro registration flow from role selection through successful signup and navigation to the complete profile screen.

title: Sign up shows inline validation for invalid email format
description: Verifies that an invalid email triggers visible validation messaging and the user remains on the signup screen.

title: Sign up shows inline validation for weak/invalid password
description: Verifies that an invalid password triggers visible validation messaging and the user remains on the signup screen.

title: Sign up blocks when password and confirm password do not match
description: Verifies that mismatched passwords show a visible error and prevent navigation away from the signup screen.

title: Role selection persists into signup context (Client)
description: Verifies that selecting Client role leads into the signup screen and the UI indicates the chosen role before submission.

title: Role selection persists into signup context (Pro)
description: Verifies that selecting Pro role leads into the signup screen and the UI indicates the chosen role before submission.

title: Email/password login routes Client user to client feed
description: Verifies that a user can log in with valid email/password and lands on the client feed experience.

title: Invalid password shows error and user can retry successfully
description: Verifies the invalid-credentials-error appears and a user can retry login without leaving the page.

title: Login form blocks submission when email is empty
description: Verifies the login form prevents submission and shows a visible validation message when email is missing.

title: Login form blocks submission when password is empty
description: Verifies the login form prevents submission and shows a visible validation message when password is missing.

title: Password field can be submitted via Enter key to log in
description: Verifies that pressing Enter from the password field submits the login form and navigates to the post-login destination.

title: Navigate from Login to Sign Up screen
description: Verifies that the user can move from the login screen to the sign up screen using an in-page control.

title: Client completes profile successfully and continues to interest selection
description: Verifies a logged-in Client can submit complete profile details and is routed to the Client interests screen.

steps.description: Type "Test Client" into the display name field
Type "Just exploring services." into the bio field

title: Pro completes profile successfully and continues to business details
description: Verifies a logged-in Pro can submit complete profile details and is routed to the Pro business details screen.

steps.description: Type "Test Pro" into the display name field
Type "Professional services provider." into the bio field

title: Validation error when display name is missing
description: Verifies the user cannot proceed when required profile fields are missing and field-level validation is shown.

steps.description: Type "" into the display name field

title: Validation error when bio exceeds allowed length (if enforced)
description: Verifies that an overly long bio triggers a visible validation message and prevents continuing.

steps.description: Type "Test User" into the display name field

title: User can remain on Complete Profile after server-side validation failure
description: Verifies that when submission fails, the user stays on the Complete Profile screen and does not navigate forward.

steps.description: Type "!@#" into the display name field

title: Profile form retains entered values after a visible validation error
description: Verifies that when a validation message is shown, previously typed values remain visible so the user can correct fields without re-entering everything.

steps.description: Type "Persistent Name" into the display name field

title: Cancel/back action does not complete onboarding (if available)
description: Verifies that using a visible back/cancel control does not submit the profile and the user remains in an onboarding-related screen.

title: Client feed loads and shows videos from the vertical feed
description: Verifies the client can open the feed and see the vertical video feed UI with content loaded.

steps.description: Click on the "Feed" tab or navigation item to open the feed
Verify element "Vertical video feed" is visible

title: Pro feed loads and shows videos from the vertical feed
description: Verifies the pro can open the feed and see the vertical video feed UI with content loaded.

steps.description: Click on the "Feed" tab or navigation item to open the feed
Verify element "Vertical video feed" is visible

title: Like a video from the feed updates the like state
description: Verifies tapping Like on a feed video updates the UI to the liked state and reflects a higher like count or active indicator.

steps.description: Click on the "Feed" tab or navigation item to open the feed
Click on the "Like" button on the currently visible video
Verify element "Liked state indicator for Like button" is visible
Verify element "Like animation/heart overlay" is visible

title: Open comments from a feed video and view the comments UI
description: Verifies the comments entry point works from the feed and the comments UI becomes visible.

steps.description: Click on the "Feed" tab or navigation item to open the feed
Click on the "Comment" button on the currently visible video
Verify element "Add a comment" input field is visible

title: Use the share action from a feed video (in-app share UI only)
description: Verifies the share entry point opens an in-app share sheet/dialog without relying on native OS dialogs.

steps.description: Click on the "Feed" tab or navigation item to open the feed
Click on the "Share" button on the currently visible video
Verify element "Share options list" is visible

title: Book action is available from a feed video
description: Verifies the feed video UI includes a booking call-to-action and that tapping it opens a booking-related UI entry point (without requiring a specific booking route).

steps.description: Click on the "Feed" tab or navigation item to open the feed

title: Feed supports pagination by loading more videos as the user scrolls
description: Verifies the feed continues loading additional content when scrolling down the vertical feed.

steps.description: Click on the "Feed" tab or navigation item to open the feed
Scroll to the bottom of the feed list
Verify element "Loading more" indicator or "Loading" spinner is visible

title: Search for pros using the discover search bar (basic happy path)
description: Verifies a logged-in user can search in Discover and see matching professional profiles in results.

steps.description: Click on "Discover" in the app navigation

title: Filter discover results by selecting a single category chip
description: Verifies category filter chips can be selected and results update accordingly.

steps.description: Click on "Discover" in the app navigation
Click on a category filter chip (for example, "Beauty" or the first visible chip)

title: Combine search text with a category filter
description: Verifies users can apply both a search query and a category filter and still see results rendered.

steps.description: Click on "Discover" in the app navigation
Click on a category filter chip (choose any visible chip)

title: Open a pro profile from discover results
description: Verifies a user can tap a pro in the results grid and reach the pro profile details view.

steps.description: Click on "Discover" in the app navigation
Click on a pro profile card in the results grid (choose the first visible result)

title: View services list for a pro after opening their profile
description: Verifies that opening a pro profile shows their services list in the booking sheet/section.

steps.description: Click on "Discover" in the app navigation
Click on a pro profile card in the results grid (choose the first visible result)

title: Search for a nonsense term shows an empty state (no results)
description: Verifies the UI handles a query with no matches by showing a no-results message or empty state.

steps.description: Click on "Discover" in the app navigation

title: Client can view Bookings screen after successful login
description: Verifies a logged-in user can reach the Client Bookings list screen and see core UI elements.

steps.description: Click on "Bookings" in the bottom navigation

title: Client bookings list shows expected sections (Upcoming/Past)
description: Verifies the bookings list UI renders the key tabs/sections for managing bookings.

steps.description: Click on "Bookings" in the bottom navigation

title: Client can switch between Upcoming and Past bookings views
description: Verifies the user can toggle bookings filters and the view updates accordingly.

steps.description: Click on "Bookings" in the bottom navigation
Verify element "Past bookings list" is visible
Verify element "Upcoming bookings list" is visible

title: Client can navigate from Profile to Bookings
description: Verifies bookings access from the profile area (alternate navigation path).

steps.description: Click on "Profile" in the bottom navigation
Click the "Bookings" option on the Profile screen

title: Bookings screen remains accessible after navigating away and back
description: Verifies the bookings screen can be revisited reliably within the same authenticated session.

steps.description: Click on "Bookings" in the bottom navigation
Click on "Discover" in the bottom navigation
Click on "Bookings" in the bottom navigation

title: Cancel an upcoming booking and see it reflected in My Bookings list
description: Verifies a client can cancel an upcoming booking and the bookings list reflects the cancelled state.

steps.description: Click on the "Bookings" tab or menu item
Click on the first booking in the "Upcoming" list

title: Cancel from booking details and confirm status shows cancelled
description: Verifies cancellation from a booking detail view results in a visible cancelled status confirmation.

steps.description: Click on the "Bookings" tab or menu item
Click on the first booking in the "Upcoming" list

title: Cancellation within 24 hours shows partial refund policy message
description: Verifies that cancelling within 24 hours shows the server-provided policy message about deposit refund.

steps.description: Click on the "Bookings" tab or menu item
Click on an upcoming booking that indicates it is within 24 hours of the appointment time
Verify text "No refund of deposit due to policy" is visible

title: Cancelled booking appears under Past or Cancelled section in My Bookings
description: Verifies a cancelled booking is not shown as active upcoming and is visible in a past/cancelled area of the bookings list.

steps.description: Click on the "Bookings" tab or menu item
Click on the "Past" tab (or "Cancelled" tab if present)

title: Invalid booking cancellation shows 'Booking not found' error and support option
description: Verifies an invalid cancellation attempt shows a 'Booking not found' message and provides a way to contact support.

steps.description: Click on the "Bookings" tab or menu item
Click on an upcoming booking and open its cancellation flow (for example, by clicking "Cancel booking")
Verify text "Booking not found" is visible

title: User can dismiss cancellation error and remain on bookings screen
description: Verifies that after a cancellation error, the user can close the message and continue using the bookings screen.

steps.description: Click on the "Bookings" tab or menu item
Click on an upcoming booking and open its cancellation flow (for example, by clicking "Cancel booking")
Click the "Close" button on the error message (or "OK" if present)

title: Login then open a static authenticated page to confirm session is established
description: Verifies that email/password login works and the user lands in an authenticated area.

title: Login then access Create Event screen (entry route exists)
description: Verifies the authenticated user can reach the create event screen from a logged-in session.

steps.description: Click on the "Create Event" button or link

title: Login then verify ticket-related area is reachable from profile
description: Verifies the user can navigate to their profile where tickets are typically accessible after purchase.

steps.description: Click on the "Profile" tab or menu item

title: Invalid login blocks access to authenticated event purchase journey entry points
description: Verifies that invalid credentials do not log the user in, preventing access to authenticated ticket purchase routes.

title: Login then open Notifications to ensure post-purchase messages area is available
description: Verifies the user can reach notification history (often used for ticket/payment updates) after login.

steps.description: Click on the "Notifications" icon or menu item

title: View client profile and default tab content renders
description: Verifies an authenticated client can open the Client Profile screen and see core profile info and tab navigation.

steps.description: Click on "Profile" in the app navigation

title: Switch between Favorites, Bookings History, and Tickets tabs
description: Verifies the user can switch profile tabs and the selected tab content area updates visibly.

steps.description: Click on "Profile" in the app navigation

title: Open Edit Profile from Client Profile screen
description: Verifies the Edit Profile button navigates to the edit profile screen.

steps.description: Click on "Profile" in the app navigation

title: Update profile fields and verify updated values appear on profile
description: Verifies a client can save changes (display name, city, bio) and see the updated values reflected on the Client Profile screen.

steps.description: Click on "Profile" in the app navigation
Type "Test User Display" into the display name field

title: Edit city and verify change is shown on profile info
description: Verifies updating the city field persists and is visible on the Client Profile screen.

steps.description: Click on "Profile" in the app navigation
Type "Test City" into the city field

title: Edit bio and verify change is shown on profile info
description: Verifies updating the bio field persists and is visible on the Client Profile screen.

steps.description: Click on "Profile" in the app navigation
Type "This is a short test bio." into the bio field

title: Cancel out of Edit Profile without saving
description: Verifies leaving the edit screen via a cancel/back control does not apply changes to the visible profile info.

steps.description: Click on "Profile" in the app navigation
Type "Unsaved Name" into the display name field

title: Update notification preferences and see confirmation on Settings
description: Verifies a signed-in user can toggle notification preferences and the UI reflects the updated state.

steps.description: Click the notification preference toggle (any one visible toggle)

title: Notification preferences persist after leaving and returning to Settings
description: Verifies notification preference toggles remain in the chosen state after navigating away and back.

steps.description: Click the notification preference toggle (any one visible toggle)

title: Sign out from Settings navigates to Login
description: Verifies the user can sign out and is taken to the login screen.

title: After sign out, user can log in again successfully
description: Verifies the app returns to a usable state after signing out by allowing a fresh login.

title: Settings screen renders core sections for a signed-in user
description: Verifies the Settings screen loads and shows key controls like notification preferences and sign out.

title: Notification preferences can be toggled multiple times without breaking UI
description: Verifies repeated toggling works and the control remains interactive and visible.

steps.description: Click the notification preference toggle (any one visible toggle)
Click the same notification preference toggle again
